reply.emotion: rushed and slightly breathless, with too much to do in too little time
notes: When modifying a noun, it changes to 바쁜 (e.g., 바쁜 하루).
Do not confuse with 정신없다, which implies being frantic or overwhelmed to the point of losing one's focus, whereas 바쁘다 simply means having a lot of tasks.

senses.definition: Having a lot of things to do and not enough time.

examples.translation: I am very busy these days because I have a lot of work.
examples.emotion: overwhelmed and tired from a heavy workload

senses.definition: Happening quickly or needing to be done without delay.

examples.translation: I felt rushed so I hurried.
examples.emotion: anxious and rushing to beat the clock

definitions: Having a lot of things to do and not enough time.
Happening quickly or needing to be done without delay.
